headline: Citigroup (C) Stock May Be Reasonable As AI Banking Hopes Grow
summary: Citigroup stock has delivered a very strong 3 year run, yet current valuation checks and the intrinsic value estimate from the Excess Returns model both still point to the shares trading below that intrinsic value. With the market debate around banks intensifying again, the question is how much of Citigroup’s recent progress is already reflected in the US$135.0 share price. headline: Data center operator Switch plans return to public markets via a $50bn IPO
summary: Investing.com -- Switch Inc. has filed confidentially for a U.S. initial public offering that could take place as early as November, Bloomberg reported, citing people familiar with the matter.
